title: Flags/positives parity pin covers only the server payload copy; the demo_store mirror the diff also edits is unpinned
detail: The test lives in the server package and imports only demo/pdf_prebake; it cannot reach client demo_store. Reverting the demo_store copy to "[]" passes every suite, so screen↔PDF divergence — this PR's named regression — can silently recur client-side.
recommended_fix: Pin the client copy too: a client test asserting demo_store's flags/positives (or rendering app detail and asserting flag labels), or hoist the canonical JSON into shared/ so both packages decode one constant.
